preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be between n - 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= d[i] <= 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each vertex's degree value di must be -1, 0, or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range 1 to n.
The number of edges provided must match the specified m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not good_subset else True
postconditions.description: If no good subset exists, output -1; otherwise, output the good subset.
The number of edges in the good subset must match the output k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in good_subset)
postconditions.description: All edge indices in the good subset must be valid and within the range of provided edges.
